name: Chile
shortSummary: Chile was among the first Latin American countries to sign a Preferential Trade Agreement with India, and the two cooperate increasingly on copper and lithium supply for India's clean-energy manufacturing needs.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Chile is a key supplier of critical minerals for Indian manufacturing and clean-energy goals.

recentDevelopments.title: Copper and lithium trade continues
recentDevelopments.description: Chile remained a steady supplier of copper and lithium carbonate to India.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: A quiet but strategically relevant relationship for India's critical-minerals needs.

historicalEvents.title: Preferential Trade Agreement
historicalEvents.description: India and Chile sign a Preferential Trade Agreement, later expanded in scope.

agreements.name: India-Chile Preferential Trade Agreement
agreements.description: Tariff-preference agreement covering a range of goods, expanded in subsequent years.
